land.text: Laguna, the 'harbor city' conquered on 22 July 1839

predecessors.note: The page names only the province of Santa Catarina and the city of Laguna.

land.text: Laguna, retaken by imperial forces 'in November' 1839

correction.text: the harbour city of Laguna and its neighbourhood in the province of Santa Catarina; rebels 'failed to take Nossa Senhora do Desterro'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, Cliopatria has no row. The page gives no territory beyond Laguna and the province and no area; the 50 km ring is the researcher's minimal reading of the republic that 'lasted for only four months'.

region.text: Laguna, 'conquered' by rebel forces on 22 July 1839

ledger.note: 29 July 1839: the Juliana Republic is proclaimed at Laguna. 'The Catarinense Republic was then proclaimed on 29 July, at the city's municipal chamber' (infobox 'Established: 29 July 1839'); the rebels 'conquered the harbor city of Laguna on 22 July 1839'.

region.text: Laguna, retaken by the imperial forces

ledger.note: 15 November 1839: imperial forces retake Laguna. Infobox 'Disestablished: 15 November 1839'; the republic 'lasted for only four months', its naval forces having been destroyed at the Massiambu River.
15 November 1839: the Juliana Republic ends. Infobox 'Disestablished: 15 November 1839'.

wars.name: Ragamuffin War (Santa Catarina front)
wars.outcome: Imperial victory: the republic, 'an extension of the Ragamuffin War started in the neighboring province of Rio Grande do Sul', fell on 15 November 1839 after its naval forces were destroyed.
wars.note: Giuseppe Garibaldi and General David Canabarro led the conquest of Laguna; the Riograndense Republic is the ally, written in am-08-e.

certainty.note: Only the city of Laguna is named; no frontier is described.

sources.title: Juliana Republic
sources.note: Laguna taken 22 July 1839, republic proclaimed 29 July 1839, disestablished 15 November 1839, capital Laguna, tied to the Ragamuffin War.

notes:
Cliopatria has no row. Under the 10-year rule this state is too short, but the riograndense-republic dossier (am-08-e) names it as a counterpart needing a dossier. One page opened (budget 1-2). The page gives no territory or area: the republic is drawn as a 50 km ring round Laguna, the researcher's minimal reading, and the page's own text (a four-month republic) is the only evidence of its size.
Dates: the page gives the capture of Laguna on 22 July, the proclamation on 29 July 1839 and the end on 15 November 1839 (infobox).
